The GitHub URL (`github.com/badcast/aimpskins`) is a plausible upstream/fork tracking page for the skin pack and does not execute any code.

There is no evidence of injected malicious code, data exfiltration, or backdoors. All operations are consistent with ordinary AUR packaging of an AIMP skin archive.
